crouch.definition:
n. the act of bending low with the limbs close to the body
v. bend one's back forward from the waist on down
crouch.translation:
n. 蹲伏, 蜷缩
vi. 蹲下, 蜷着, 缩着
vt. 低头

crouched.definition:
v bend one's back forward from the waist on down
v sit on one's heels
crouched.translation: v. 屈膝, 蹲伏( crouch的过去式和过去分词 )

crouches.definition:
n the act of bending low with the limbs close to the body
v bend one's back forward from the waist on down
v sit on one's heels
crouches.translation:
n. 蹲着的姿势( crouch的名词复数 )
v. 屈膝, 蹲伏( crouch的第三人称单数 )

crouching.definition:
v bend one's back forward from the waist on down
v sit on one's heels
crouching.translation: vi. 蹲伏, 蜷缩（crouch的现在分词）

crouchings.definition:
plural of crouching
v bend one's back forward from the waist on down
v sit on one's heels
crouchings.translation: (crouching 的复数) vi. 蹲伏, 蜷缩（crouch的现在分词）

croup.definition: n. a disease of infants and young children; harsh coughing and hoarseness and fever and difficult breathing
croup.translation:
n. 哮吼, 四脚动物的臀部
[医] 格鲁布, 哮吼

croupade.definition:
n. A leap in which the horse pulls up his hind legs toward
   his belly.

croupe.definition: n the part of an animal that corresponds to the human buttocks

crouper.translation: n. 【病理学】格鲁布, 哮吼, (假膜性)喉头炎

croupier.definition: n. someone who collects and pays bets at a gaming table
croupier.translation: n. (赌场上的)管理人, 副主持人

croupiers.definition: n. someone who collects and pays bets at a gaming table
croupiers.translation: n. 赌场上的总管理人, 副主持人( croupier的复数形式 )

croupous.definition:
a. Relating to or resembling croup; especially, attended
   with the formation of a deposit or membrane like that found in
   membranous croup; as, croupous laryngitis.
croupous.translation:
a. 哮吼性的
[医] 格鲁布性的, 哮吼性的

croupous bronchitis.translation: [医] 格鲁布性支气管炎, 纤维蛋白性支气管炎

croupous inflammation.translation: [医] 格鲁布性炎, 假膜性炎

croupous membranes.translation: [医] 格鲁布膜(纤维蛋白浮膜)

croupous pneumonia.translation: [医] 格鲁布性肺炎, 大叶性肺炎

croupous rhinitis.translation: [医] 格鲁布性鼻炎, 纤维蛋白性鼻炎

croups.definition:
plural of croup
n. a disease of infants and young children; harsh coughing and hoarseness and fever and difficult breathing
croups.translation:
(croup 的复数) n. 哮吼, 四脚动物的臀部
[医] 格鲁布, 哮吼

croupy.definition: a resembling or arising from or indicating croup
croupy.translation: a. 义膜性的, 格鲁布性的

croustade.definition:
n. Bread baked in a mold, and scooped out, to serve minces
   upon.

croustades.definition:
plural of croustade
n. Bread baked in a mold, and scooped out, to serve minces
   upon.
croustades.translation: (croustade 的复数) [建] 脆皮实馅小面包

crouton.definition: n. a small piece of toasted or fried bread; served in soup or salads
crouton.translation: n. 油煎碎面包片, 烤的碎面包片

croutons.definition: n. a small piece of toasted or fried bread; served in soup or salads
croutons.translation: n. （常放在汤里吃的）油煎面包块, 烤碎面包块( crouton的复数形式 )

crouzon's disease.translation: [医] 克鲁宗氏病, 颅骨面骨发育不全
